accuracy.evidence: Matches Y1 measure mass/weight: equal non-standard units on a balance, record number+unit, begin grams; size≠mass stated.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets bigger=heavier, unequal cubes, number without unit, wrong scale reading, confusing fullness/height with mass in lab why() and adult notes.

lab_distinct.evidence: Lab teaches measuring with cube units and recording — distinct from qualitative heavy/light+full/empty (flagheavy) and capacity cups (flagcups).

lab_teaches.evidence: Learner tips balance, adds cubes to level, records units, picks heavier stone, reads scale pointer, then challenge.

predictions.evidence: Wrong options (size-only, no unit, bigger always heavier, colour/height) overturned by balance/cubes/record/biglight/scale tasks.

challenge_feedback.evidence: why() names tall/full/heaviest/wins, random/never/nohelp/cant/up, doodle/empty/length/leaves slips specifically.

readability.evidence: Ages 5–6 wording: short kid lines; mass, balance, cubes, grams named plainly.

no_filler.evidence: No delve/journey phrasing; each line teaches measuring, a mistake to reject, or recording units.

mobile.evidence: Young layout with big lbtn controls and canvas taps; narrow font sizes mirrored from flagcups pattern.

accessibility.evidence: Every canvas action has a button twin; live aria-label via say(); challenge buttons in a labelled group.

sources: NC Year 1 Mathematics — Measurement: measure and begin to record mass/weight
NCETM / DfE ready-to-progress: compare mass; use non-standard then standard units
